anchors.quote: the area of the premises that is registered for export operations

export operations of that kind in relation to the plants or plant products (other than treatment of the plants or plant products) must be carried out at a property that is accredited for export operations of that kind in relation to the plants or plant products and that importing country
An assessment of prescribed plants or plant products must be carried out at an establishment that is registered to carry out export operations in relation to the plants or plant products.

notes: The two PRIMARY_NORM candidates (rules2021:2-4(1)(d) and rules2021:9-8(1)) are grouped under SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION in the validated RuleSetRelation. They jointly ground a single holistic proposition about the area of premises registered for export operations, without creating separate ALL children. No logical connector is manufactured; the proposition is expressed as a single atom with multiple legal bases.
